info.name: Infy_LearnX Platform
info.description: Full endpoint coverage for the Infy_LearnX microservices platform, run through api-gateway (http://localhost:8080), except one request that deliberately targets user-service directly (http://localhost:8081) because /api/batches is an internal, non-gateway-routed contract by design (see docs/traceability-and-compliance-review.md). All CREATE requests use dynamic values so the collection is safely re-runnable. Note: the platform has no DELETE endpoints anywhere in its design (api-contract.md defines only GET/POST/PUT/PATCH) — lifecycle changes use status transitions (cancel/reregister/revoke) instead of hard deletes, per data-model.md's persistence guidelines.
